## Checking `one.go`

The **first** thing to settle is which of these holds:

- the file was read before it was written
- the file was written before it was read

```go
func main() {
	println("one")
}
```

So the read has to come first.
A plain thought with no markup in it at all.

| what | when |
| --- | --- |
| read | first |
| write | second |
The read came first, and the file holds `one`.
